scope.object: first multiwise Davenport corridors with a support-four maximal atom
scope.claim_ceiling: exact representation-depth and support-growth theorems; no exact D_3(C_7^3) value

claims.statement: The type-a=2 light-overlap ceiling and every light-direction radial lifting cost have the stated closed formulas.
claims.limitations: Does not eliminate the remaining type-a=2 companion geometry.

claims.statement: The maximum type-a=2 representation depth on every coordinate-sum fiber [P+Q]_p=w is the stated four-region piecewise function M_p(w,C).
claims.limitations: A fiber maximum is an upper envelope; a particular point can be shallower.

claims.statement: For arbitrary canonical type a, the exact cost of every overlap-plane target C s+D g is the stated two-variable minimization nu_a(C,D).
claims.limitations: This is a certificate interface, not a complete rank-three elimination.

claims.statement: For every prime p>=7, the complete canonical type-a=3 support-three rank-two equality face is empty.
claims.limitations: The cyclic length-four index-one input is donor-owned; types a=1,2 remain separate.

claims.statement: For canonical types a>=4 with both overlap directions available, c_light+c_heavy<=a-2.
claims.limitations: Bounds the overlap box but does not eliminate all boxes.

claims.statement: Doubling eliminates every a>=4 rank-three box with smaller new-value multiplicity greater than H and forces all survivors onto the stated thin boundary.
claims.limitations: Thin-boundary edge regimes remain.

claims.statement: Scalar three eliminates the central portion of the a>=4 thin boundary and leaves only four explicit edge regimes.
claims.limitations: No claim is made that all four edge regimes are empty.

claims.statement: For prime p>=13 with p congruent to 1 modulo 4, both standard high-multiplicity families on the top type-a=2 overlap face are empty.
claims.limitations: The prime-uniform classification into the standard families is still open.

claims.statement: At p=7, the canonical type-a=2 rank-three support-four first-corridor equality face is empty.
claims.limitations: Specific to p=7, the first corridor, and exact total support six.

claims.statement: In the (8,10,19) corridor over C_7^3, a maximal pair containing a support-four length-19 atom has total support at least seven.
claims.limitations: The statement is about the maximal pair before adjoining the third atom.

claims.statement: In the (9,9,19) corridor, all 1634 short-free completions of the 26 exact-support-six maximal-pair candidates admit four disjoint zero-sums.
claims.limitations: This is a finite C_7^3 closure and not a prime-uniform theorem.

claims.statement: A hypothetical length-37 obstruction over C_7^3 containing a support-four length-19 atom cannot remain in the support-six maximal-pair face in either maximal corridor.
claims.limitations: Does not exclude maximal atoms of support at least five or prove D_3(C_7^3)=36.

claims.statement: For every prime p>=7, every first-corridor maximal pair with a support-four maximal atom has support at least seven.
claims.limitations: Rank-two high-overlap and rank-three edge regimes remain.

claims.statement: The light-share rank-two type-a=1 layers c>=5 are empty.
claims.limitations: No prime-uniform elimination is currently proved.

claims.statement: The light-share rank-two type-a=2 layers c>=5 are empty.
claims.limitations: Only the standard top-overlap families are eliminated.

claims.statement: All four a>=4 rank-three edge regimes surviving scalar three are empty.
claims.limitations: The V8 theorem stops at the four edge regimes.

claims.statement: The exceptional rank-three canonical types a=2,3 are empty for every prime.
claims.limitations: Only the p=7 type-a=2 face is closed.

claims.statement: All length-37 obstruction faces with maximal-atom support at least five are empty.
claims.limitations: The present paper spine is support-four conditional.

claims.statement: The one-projective-collision support-eight Type-A face is empty.
claims.limitations: The existing support-eight theorem is not a full Type-A closure.
Neither the upper bound nor a complete obstruction classification is established here.

claims.statement: The paper's main theorem suite is externally novel and has priority.
claims.limitations: Requires external database, thesis, citation-network, and expert subtraction.

claims.statement: The theorem stack is ready for top-specialist manuscript development.
claims.limitations: External mathematical review, full prior-art subtraction, and a polished manuscript remain required.
